question: Does writing along linearly decoded puck-position directions causally change the model's rendered puck position?
labelSource: puck centroids measured from rendered categorical pixels
directionMethod: minimum-norm hidden direction whose linear ridge decoder predicts a pure x or y coordinate change, normalized to unit activation norm

readouts.spatial_mean: same write applied to every final-frame spatial token
readouts.puck_token: token containing the rendered puck centroid
readouts.puck_token_jacobian: same puck token, but oriented by the average downstream gradient of the next rendered puck centroid
